name: Long Term AF Database: Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation Dynamics
description: The Long Term AF Database is an extensive clinical electrocardiographic dataset compiled by Northwestern University and Rush University Medical Center in Chicago. It contains 84 continuous two-lead Holter ECG recordings, typically 24 to 25 hours long (sampled at 128 Hz with 12-bit resolution), from 84 subjects with paroxysmal or sustained atrial fibrillation. The collection was designed to study the long-term temporal dynamics and abrupt changes in fibrillatory wave frequency and amplitude preceding spontaneous termination and re-initiation of AF episodes.
